text: A 'Make this a goal' entry point from routines, pots, exams' readiness, Collection titles and Money budgets so goals are created where the data lives
evidence: Only exams have it: the exam page's Goals card offers '+ Add a goal' with templates (js/modules/exams.js:754-761, goalTemplates :783); a pot only links to an existing money-save goal (js/modules/money.js:1399,1417) and routines, Collection titles and budgets have no create-a-goal action (no goalEditor/newGoal callers outside goals.js).
note: You could start a goal straight from a routine, a savings pot, a budget or a Collection title, with it already filled in, instead of going to the Goals page and picking the type again.

text: Japanese and Mind goal types (facets reviewed, lessons finished, Daily 15 days) to match the other study spaces
evidence: Japanese and Mind already have 'Pass reviews' and 'Finish lessons' goal types, plus Japanese 'Hold the kana' and 'Words stable' (js/core/goals.js:933-948); there is no Mind Daily 15 days type (no 'daily' in js/core/goals*.js).
note: Goals could also count the days you did Mind's Daily 15, to sit beside the reviews and lessons goals Japanese and Mind already have.

text: Goal page: list what counted (the sessions, titles or transactions inside the range) with links, so a goal is auditable
evidence: The goal page (detail(), js/modules/goals.js:585-651) shows the pace chart, period history, milestones, links and a 'How it is counted' card that is a sentence of text (countedText, :785-791); no list of the sessions, titles or transactions that made up the figure.
note: Each goal's page would list exactly which sessions, titles or payments counted towards it, each one clickable, so you can check why the number is what it is.

text: Register each study space's daily plan and Money's notices with KOS.today so Home's ladder and Due card cover the whole OS
evidence: KOS.today already carries every study space's daily (spaces(): Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives, js/core/today.js:327-432) and Money's notices (money(), :288-313); Home's Focus ladder step 3b reads KOS.today.spaces() (js/modules/home.js:286-296), the Due card reads its reviews (:493) and the day card shows Money's notice (:867-970).
note: Already there: Home's 'what next' card and its due list already include Code, Japanese, Mind, Creatives and Money's bills.

text: Use one subject registry (KOS.subjects) for every Reports surface
evidence: reports.js:39 and reportstory.js:37 read KOS.subjects.ids(), but js/core/report.js:30 still hard-codes ['compsci','maths','it'], reportwords.js:21-22 keeps its own name tables, and reports.js:44,1075 and reportstory.js:79 keep private CS/Maths/IT label maps.
note: Every Reports page would name and colour subjects the same way, and a new study space would show up in Reports without anyone having to add it by hand.

text: Unscheduled 'practise this lesson again' mode that moves no facet
evidence: A done lesson offers '▶ Practise again' (js/modules/jatopic.js:268-271), but the learn session it opens only asks the lesson's facets that are due today plus earlier misses as practice (js/modules/jarun.js:381-406), so with nothing due there is no full unscheduled run through the lesson.
note: You could run through a finished Japanese lesson again at any time just for practice, without it changing when anything comes back for review.

text: Japanese goal types and a Reports card (f.ja)
evidence: Japanese goal types exist (ja-reviews, ja-lessons, ja-kana-held, ja-words-stable, js/core/goals.js:938-948) and Reports saves f.ja (js/core/report.js:1090, spaceFacts :704) and draws a Japanese card (jaCard, js/modules/reportlong.js:54-67; used in reports.js:761).
note: Already there: you can set Japanese goals and your weekly and monthly reports have a Japanese card.

text: ja_overview / ja_lesson Assistant tools and a KOS.today entry
evidence: The Assistant has ja_overview and ja_lesson tools (js/core/aitools.js:1027, :1044) and KOS.today builds a Japanese row in spaces() (js/core/today.js:330, :364-386).
note: Already there: Kurenai can read your Japanese progress and lessons, and Japanese shows in your day plan.

text: Leech recovery flow (relearn from the lesson, Back in the schedule)
evidence: Items that keep slipping are listed in a Rework card (KOS.ja.rework, js/core/ja.js:230; reworkRows/reworkCard, js/modules/japanese.js:240-263, :514-518) and leeches at 8 lapses are dropped from the queue (js/core/jasrs.js:28,104,115), but the rows have no action: nothing relearns the item from its lesson or puts it back in the schedule.
note: Japanese words you keep forgetting would get a button to learn them again from their lesson and then go back into your normal reviews, instead of just sitting in a list.

text: Input logging through a Japanese immersion Focus choice
evidence: The store and display exist (KOS.ja addInput tallies read/listen/raw/jpSub, js/core/ja.js:393-395; 'Input this week' card, js/modules/japanese.js:284-295), but nothing calls addInput and Focus has no Japanese immersion choice (no 'immersion' in js/modules/focus.js; ja.js:422-424 says no input logging yet).
note: You could start a Focus session as 'Japanese immersion' while watching or reading in Japanese, and the time would count in Japanese's weekly input and the Immersion badge.

text: Author apply/explain/evaluate routes for every F1 concept (or per-concept rung sets) before F2
evidence: The ladder only offers rungs the content can reach (reach(), js/core/mind.js:285-311); counting the shipped F1 content (js/data/content/mind-f1.js) gives 2 of 16 concepts with all four rungs, 10 with no Explain route, 6 with no Apply and 13 with no Evaluate.
note: Every idea in Mind's first unit could be taken all the way up its four steps (remember, explain, apply, judge), instead of most stopping at the first step or two.

text: Mind facts in Reports (milestones, positions changed, Journal counts) and a Mind goal domain
evidence: Reports saves f.mind with lessons, checkpoints, paths, positions taken and changed, and Journal counts (spaceFacts, js/core/report.js:704-716, :1090, :1264, :1338) and draws a Mind card (mindCard, js/modules/reportlong.js:69-80); Mind is a goal domain with mind-reviews and mind-lessons types (js/core/goals.js:44, :938-942).
note: Already there: reports show your Mind milestones, changed positions and Journal counts, and you can set Mind goals.

text: Tension pairs content (TENSIONS is empty; the UI path is unreachable)
evidence: KOS_MIND.TENSIONS is declared and read (js/data/mind.js:13,53,63; js/core/mind.js:618; js/modules/mind.js:743) but no content file calls tension(), so the list is empty and the tension screen can never be reached.
note: Mind would pair two lessons that pull against each other and ask you to weigh them, a feature whose screen exists but has no questions written for it yet.
